dimensions.assessment: Affects postal customers who purchase semipostal stamps and organizations receiving breast cancer research funds.
Extends an existing program without altering its fundamental structure.
dimensions.evidence: extend the authority of the United States Postal Service to issue a semipostal to raise funds for breast cancer research.

dimensions.assessment: Continues voluntary fundraising via stamp purchases for research funds.
A minor amendment changing a single year in existing law.
dimensions.evidence: Section 414(h) of title 39, United States Code, is amended by striking '2027' and inserting '2037'.

dimensions.assessment: Extends the program duration for a ten-year period until 2037.

missing_information: Historical revenue generated or projected funds to be raised by the stamp extension.
importance_detail.rationale: Extends the expiration date for the U.S. Postal Service's authority to issue a semipostal stamp for breast cancer research by ten years, maintaining existing fundraising operations.
